🎬 Room (2015)

Room follows Joy Newsome, a young woman who has been held captive for years in a small, enclosed shed, where she raises her five-year-old son, Jack, under extraordinary circumstances. Having spent his entire life inside the room, Jack believes that the tiny space represents the entire world, unaware of the vast reality waiting beyond its walls. Despite the terrifying conditions of their captivity, Joy does everything possible to create a loving and imaginative environment for her son, teaching him through stories, games, and everyday routines while protecting him from the truth about their situation. As Jack grows older and becomes increasingly curious, Joy realizes that she must find a way for them to escape and experience freedom. After developing a dangerous plan, mother and son face a life-changing journey that challenges everything Jack has ever understood. However, escaping captivity is only the beginning, as both must adjust to an unfamiliar world filled with overwhelming experiences, complicated relationships, and emotional challenges. While Jack discovers the wonders of ordinary life for the first time, Joy struggles with the lasting effects of her trauma and the difficulties of rebuilding her future. Combining powerful performances, emotional storytelling, and unforgettable moments, the film explores motherhood, survival, resilience, trauma, freedom, and the extraordinary strength of unconditional love.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Psychological Thriller

⭐ IMDb: 8.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 58m • R

🎥 Director: Lenny Abrahamson
